results.title: Jaffna Bulls taking rugby to a hi-tech level
results.description: Sri Lanka’s inaugural Next XV rugby tournament is set for kick-off and one team calling itself the Jaffna Bulls is carving out a distinct identity driven by modern performance analytics, cutting-edge technology and a deep commitment to developing local talent according to the team’s promoters.
